CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.latch_budget_receipts()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if new.enabled and not old.enabled and (new.legacy_grants_expire_at is null or new.legacy_grants_expire_at>clock_timestamp()
  or not new.storage_verified or not new.cleanup_worker_verified or not new.content_worker_verified
  or not exists(select 1 from storage.buckets where id='trip-attachments' and not public and file_size_limit=10485760 and allowed_mime_types @> array['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','application/pdf'])) then
  raise exception 'Receipt activation requires verified HTTP, scoped content worker, cleanup and expired legacy upload grants' using errcode='55000';end if;
 new.activated:=old.activated or new.enabled;return new;end $function$

functions.body: select bucket='trip-attachments' and (path ~ '^trips/[^/]+/attachments/actual_expense/[^/]+/receipts/' or app_private.receipts_activated() and (path ~ '^trips/[^/]+/attachments/actual_expense/' or exists(select 1 from public.attachments where target_type='actual_expense' and file_url=path)) or exists(select 1 from app_private.budget_receipt_intents where object_path=path) or exists(select 1 from app_private.budget_receipt_cleanup where object_path=path))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.receipt_path_protected(bucket text, path text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select bucket='trip-attachments' and (path ~ '^trips/[^/]+/attachments/actual_expense/[^/]+/receipts/' or app_private.receipts_activated() and (path ~ '^trips/[^/]+/attachments/actual_expense/' or exists(select 1 from public.attachments where target_type='actual_expense' and file_url=path)) or exists(select 1 from app_private.budget_receipt_intents where object_path=path) or exists(select 1 from app_private.budget_receipt_cleanup where object_path=path))
$function$
